sents.t: My New Year’s resolution was to exercise more, so in January I joined Oakville Fitness.
It costs twenty-five dollars a month.
On my first day, a trainer named Jasmine showed me around.
“How often do you exercise?” she asked.
“Honestly, I hardly ever exercise,” I said.
“I sometimes play soccer with Carlos, but only in summer.”
Jasmine made a plan for me.
“You should come three times a week. Always warm up for ten minutes first, and never forget to drink water.”
Now I usually go to the gym on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday before work.
I always start on the treadmill.
Then I lift weights, and sometimes I take a yoga class.
Yoga is hard for me, because I’m not very flexible!
The gym is always crowded in January.
Jasmine says, “Every January, lots of new people come. By March, most of them stop.”
After three weeks, I feel stronger, and I sleep better.
My legs often hurt, but I’m happy.
